title: Setting Up Your Environment
description: Get your machine ready for Spring Boot development.

slides.title: What Do You Need? 🛠️
slides.content:
# Three Core Ingredients

1. **Java Development Kit (JDK)** – Version 17 or later.
2. **An IDE** – IntelliJ IDEA (Community is free) or VS Code with Java extensions.
3. **Maven** – Build tool (comes bundled with Spring Boot projects).

Don’t worry – we’ll walk you through each step!
